title: Follow the data and outside changes

questions.question: Which of these is an input to find_official_website even though it is not a parameter?
questions.explanation: The function reads SAMPLE_WEB from the module, so it is a hidden input. The name is a parameter, the classifier is not used here, and the return value is an output.

questions.question: Which line in suggest_company_category makes a change outside the return value?
questions.explanation: Saving to the store is a side effect: it changes state that other code can see later. The other lines read data, compare values, or return.

questions.question: Why is it a problem that both find_official_website and read_about_page know the shape of SAMPLE_WEB?
options: It makes the code run twice as slowly.
Python forbids two functions reading one variable.
A change to the data's shape must be made in two places.
It hides the return value from the caller.
questions.explanation: Shared design knowledge is information leakage: one change to the shape now touches two functions. Speed is not the issue here, and Python allows shared reads.
